summary: Completed public-site regression testing for dashboard navigation, produce actions, buyer-request filtering, generic routes, mobile menu, and starter API endpoints.

integration_issues.issue: Initial test used view-tomato-button, but implementation exposes view-request-tomato-button; corrected selector and confirmed click works.

action_items: No blocking fixes identified. Keep data-testid naming documented for future test authors.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard, produce inventory, and buyer requests are local in-memory mocked UI data; no Supabase integration is present, so persistence across reloads is not provided.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_review status record through POST /api/status for API verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop routes, produce sold/add flows, Tomato filtering, View request, mobile menu, overflow, and API GET/POST status were covered. Supabase/auth flows remain unavailable because the app contains no Supabase client or auth implementation.
rca of the issue: The only initial failure was a test selector assumption; the generated request selector includes the literal request prefix. The corrected selector passed.
